name: arcade
description: Retro games in a Claude Code pane that run while Claude works and freeze the moment it needs you.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the arcade: auto, en, de, fr, es, pt, it, ja, zh, ko or ru. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; so does a value that is none of these.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: auto, unicode or ascii. unicode draws with block symbols; ascii keeps every cell one column wide (for CJK terminals). auto picks ascii for Chinese, Japanese and Korean; so does a value that is none of these.

sound.title: Sound on pause
sound.description: Chime when Claude needs you while the arcade is open (macOS only).
